name: eviolite
effect: Held by a Pokémon that is not fully evolved : Holder has 1.5× Defense and Special Defense.
shortEffect: Held: Holder has 1.5× Defense and Special Defense, as long as it’s not fully evolved.

flavorTextEntries.text: A mysterious evolutionary lump. When held, it raises the Defense and Sp. Def of a Pokémon that can still evolve.
A mysterious Evolutionary lump. When held by a Pokémon that can still evolve, it raises both Defense and Sp. Def.
